items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Some people think that Jack Carey, you know, it was called Play Jack Carey or something, huh? ... [INTERVIEWEE] We used to have a habit of playing, going around the bell.

ctx.x: I think, uh, who did really feature that Tiger Rag really was that Dixieland band.

Red. Yeah. But do you think that... Some people think that Jack Carey, you know, it was called Play Jack Carey or something, huh? You see, I think all Red Nichols is... I think all that thing come out.
We used to have a habit of playing, going around the bell.
